skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature, role, and functions of advertising; grasp the economic, social, and legal aspects of advertising.
Analyze consumer reception in advertising; understand the psychological and social factors influencing consumer behavior.
Develop and implement media planning strategies; allocate advertising budgets effectively.
Create and design effective advertising messages; develop creative strategies for advertising campaigns.
Work effectively in groups; analyze advertising activities in specific organizations.
Evaluate the effectiveness of advertising campaigns; propose appropriate advertising strategies.
Understand legal and ethical issues in advertising; apply ethical principles in advertising practices.
Prepare and deliver presentations effectively; communicate advertising strategies clearly.
Conduct research on advertising; analyze data and draw conclusions.
Develop strategic plans for advertising campaigns; integrate various media channels.
